cards.card_text: True or false: Jesus says the scribes and Pharisees look righteous on the outside but are full of hypocrisy and wickedness on the inside.
cards.verse_text: In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
cards.snippet: …appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.

cards.verse_text: Jesus began to speak first to His disciples: “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
cards.snippet: …to His disciples: “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

cards.verse_text: The other Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray.
cards.snippet: The other Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray.

cards.card_text: Paul says they're influenced by the hypocrisy of liars, whose consciences are seared with a hot iron.
cards.verse_text: Now the Spirit expressly states that in later times some will abandon the faith to follow deceitful spirits and the teachings of demons, influenced by the hypocrisy of liars, whose consciences are seared with a hot iron.
cards.snippet: …to follow deceitful spirits and the teachings of demons, influenced by the hypocrisy of liars, whose consciences are seared with a hot iron.

cards.card_text: Peter tells the believers to get rid of most of their malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy and slander.
cards.verse_text: Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
cards.snippet: Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
